heading: The PICO questions in Box 2.4.3.1 were designed to form the basis for the evidence search, retrieval and analysis.
data: Box 2.4.3.1 PICO questions 1. Should the MTBDRsl test be used to guide clinical decisions to use fluoroquinolones in patients with confirmed MDR/RR-TB?
